Repository-authored classification label consumed by the shared body overview during site preparation.
Hubble OPAL Minnaert coefficient of the 2025b color map (F467M, F547M, F657N), red channel (F657N): the correction OPAL divided out of the map, which the lighting overlay puts back.

references.evidence: The OPAL README's Minnaert table gives k = 0.5 for F657N, the correction applied to remove limb darkening before projection. The fitted phase range is the Earth-based phase of the map's epoch, 0.93-0.99 degrees on 24-25 August 2025, from JPL Horizons; the README states no angle ranges. The fitted emission range ends at 79.5 degrees: the outermost pixel of the WFC3/UVIS disc at the map's epoch (angular diameter from JPL Horizons, 0.0395 arcsec UVIS pixels), beyond which the observation resolved nothing.
